hotels.name: Cape Cadogan Boutique Hotel
hotels.highlights: Set in a Victorian building dating back to the 19th century, blending history with modern comforts. Close to the vibrant Kloof Street, known for its art galleries and excellent dining options. A cozy atmosphere with personalized service, perfect for exploring local culture.

hotels.name: Gorgeous George by Avaton
hotels.highlights: A beautifully restored building with a mix of contemporary design and historic elements, reminiscent of the area’s rich history. Features a rooftop pool with stunning views of the city and Table Mountain. Situated near the famous St. George’s Cathedral and a short walk to several art galleries and local markets.

hotels.name: The Charles Café
hotels.highlights: Nestled in the lush suburb of Newlands, offering a tranquil setting with access to several parks and historical sites. Renowned for its fantastic on-site café and restaurant serving farm-to-table meals that reflect local flavors. Close to the South African Rugby Museum and the historic Groot Constantia wine estate.
